Pins body.metadata.user_id non-null on the MAIN /v1/messages request (nth:0 = NEWEST = MAIN per runner _nth_select — CRITICAL: aux/title frames lack metadata post-cut, so the pin must land on main or a ne-on-missing-path FAIL would mask the green). RED today (path missing); GREEN when the cut emits the non-null OS-user hash on the main request.
